reason: Carlisle makes building envelope products (single-ply roofing, polyiso insulation, weatherproofing, air and vapor barriers) sold to contractors and distributors. PPG makes paints, coatings and sealants for many industries, including architectural, protective and aerospace uses. Both manufacture and sell products. They overlap only at the edges: coatings and sealants for buildings, and aerospace sealants. PPG does not show roofing membranes or insulation, which are Carlisle's core products. Both sell to some building contractors, but PPG's base is much wider (automotive, packaging, industrial, consumers). That is partial overlap, so the grade is adjacent.
